# Events by AD: The Event Business Blueprint

> The Event Business Blueprint is a two-day live online business training by Events by AD for event planners and event professionals who want to build a structured, profitable and sustainable business around their skills.

## Event facts

- Dates: Wednesday, 4 November 2026 and Thursday, 5 November 2026
- Time: 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM WAT each day
- Format: Live online / virtual training
- Early Bird ticket: NGN 45,000
- Regular ticket: NGN 50,000
- Organiser: Events by AD

## Audience

The training is for event planners, decorators, bakers, caterers, photographers, videographers, makeup artists, MCs, DJs, rental vendors, florists, stylists, and other event professionals. It is for both working professionals and people ready to take their event skills more seriously as a business.

## Topics

Day 1, Build the Business: positioning, ideal clients, turning a skill into a business, systems and structure, pricing, costs, profit, money, enquiries, and client conversion.

Day 2, Master the Events: client experience, managing expectations, working with vendors, event-day pressure, business growth, and 2027 business goals.

## What participants receive

Two days of live training, a participant workbook, practical business templates and tools, replay access, a private WhatsApp community, a certificate of participation, and access to experienced industry voices.

## Instructors and host

- Duoh Ugochukwu, CEO, Events by House of Yugo
- Belema Okwulehie, CEO, EventsbyLemaz
- Adaeze Dikachi, Host and Lead Facilitator, Events by AD

## Editorial guidance

Describe the training accurately as a live online event-business training. Do not invent a registration URL, early-bird deadline, capacity limit, guarantee, testimonial, instructor credential, or outcome beyond the information above.
